_doc: Run registry. A run (R<NN>) is one fixed setup: prompt, data and training settings. Each model tried under that setup is a member R<NN>-<model>. 'members' maps a result folder under results/runs/ (with _seed<N> removed) to its run and model tag. src.evaluation.summarize_runs groups the dev-score tables by this file. A member with "external": true is a published model we only downloaded and scored: we do not have its training code or data, so it cannot be retrained, ablated or used as a base for further experiments. 'quality_files' maps a quality result in results/quality/ (file stem) to its Q<NN> ID when the file name does not start with it; src.quality.summarize_quality reads it.

reference._doc: Published model repeated as a reference row in the split_summary.md table of every run with more than one model (markdown only; the CSV keeps one row per model).

runs.R01: Published LahjatBERT models, downloaded and scored (not trained by us)
runs.R02: Real only, D4 with diacritics stripped from the training text (strip_diacritics), otherwise identical to R07
runs.R03: Real only (condition 1), D1, our settings: dropout 0.3, 2 epochs, macro-F1 epoch selection, threshold 0.3
runs.R04: Real only, D1, LahjatBERT's settings: dropout 0.1, 3 epochs, micro-F1 epoch selection
runs.G01: Generator feasibility: 4-bit NF4 load, 20 sentences over 5 dialects, minimal prompt (scripts/check_generators.py)
runs.R05: Real only, D2 (D1 without zero-label and all-18 texts), otherwise identical to R03
runs.R06: Real only, D3 (D1 without all-18 texts; zero-label kept), otherwise identical to R03
runs.R07: Real only, D4 (D1 without zero-label texts; all-18 kept), otherwise identical to R03
runs.R08: Real only, D1, 7-9B decoder LLMs as classifiers: 4-bit QLoRA (r 16, alpha 32, all projections), lr 1e-4, effective batch 24, 2 epochs, macro-F1 epoch selection, threshold 0.3
runs.Q01: Quality reference: random 2,000-text sample of D1 (seed 42), src/quality/measure.py
runs.Q02: Quality of the G01 outputs (20 sentences per generator) and of a size-matched real D1 set with the same dialect counts
runs.S01: Scorer validation against the human MLADI dev labels: CAMeLBERT DID-nadi, DID-madar, Sentence-ALDi
runs.R10: Real only, D1, R03 settings + LahjatBERT's cardinality curriculum: 18 stages (order 18,2,3,1,12,7,4,15,17,11,6,8,16,14,5,9,10,13), 1 epoch per stage, zero-label texts in no stage
runs.R11: Real only, D1, R03 settings + LahjatBERT's ALDi curriculum: 4 cumulative ALDi-bin stages (order 4,1,3,2), 1 epoch per stage
runs.R12: Real only, D1, dropout 0.3, 2 epochs, macro-F1 selection (= R03 setup, rerun on current code)
runs.R13: Real only, D1, dropout 0.1, 2 epochs, macro-F1 selection
runs.R14: Real only, D1, dropout 0.3, 3 epochs, macro-F1 selection
runs.R15: Real only, D1, dropout 0.1, 3 epochs, macro-F1 selection (= R04 except selection metric)
runs.R17: Real only, D1, dropout 0.2, 2 epochs, macro-F1 selection
runs.R18: Real only, D1, dropout 0.5, 2 epochs, macro-F1 selection
runs.R19: Real only, D1, dropout 0.2, 3 epochs, macro-F1 selection
runs.R20: Real only, D1, dropout 0.5, 3 epochs, macro-F1 selection
runs.R21: Real only, D1, dropout 0.1, 4 epochs, macro-F1 selection, patience 2
runs.R22: Real only, D1, dropout 0.2, 4 epochs, macro-F1 selection, patience 2
runs.R23: Real only, D1, dropout 0.3, 4 epochs, macro-F1 selection, patience 2
runs.R24: Real only, D1, dropout 0.5, 4 epochs, macro-F1 selection, patience 2
